purpose: Two cancellations of one real source Closure retain two distinct copied receivers and two edges to its shared capture; source survives first abort and retires after second, raw tokens/retvals retire each time, no Gen is created, and both copies survive shutdown callbacks.

<?php
class CaptureRepeat99R { function __destruct() { echo 'CAPTURE|'; } }
class TokenRepeat99R {
    public $label;
    function __construct($label) { $this->label = $label; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'T', $this->label, '|'; }
}
class OriginRepeat99R {
    function capture($captured) { return function (&$slot) use ($captured) { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; try { yield $slot; } finally { echo 'BAD-FIN|'; } }; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class MakerRepeat99R {
    public $label;
    function __construct($label) { $this->label = $label; }
    function __destruct() { echo 'M', $this->label, '|'; }
}
class ReturnedRepeat99R {
    public $token;
    function __construct($token) { $this->token = $token; }
    function __destruct() {
        global $round, $weakSource, $weakOld, $weakMaker, $weakToken, $weakCapture;
        echo 'DTOR|', $round, '|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakOld->get() instanceof OriginRepeat99R, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $this->token === $weakToken->get(), '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureRepeat99R, '|';
        try { Fiber::suspend('RET'); echo 'BAD-RESUME|'; }
        finally { echo 'DTOR-FIN|', $round, '|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakOld->get() instanceof OriginRepeat99R, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof TokenRepeat99R, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureRepeat99R, '|'; }
    }
}
function WarnRepeat99R($severity, $message) {
    global $round, $warnings, $weakToken, $weakReturned;
    $warnings = $warnings + 1; echo 'WARN|', $round, '|', $severity === E_WARNING, '|';
    $result = new ReturnedRepeat99R($weakToken->get()); $weakReturned = WeakReference::create($result); return $result;
}
function RunRepeat99R() { global $round, $source, $maker, $token, $g; echo 'CALL|', $round, '|'; $g = $source->call($maker, $token); echo 'BAD-CREATED|'; }
function ShutdownRepeat99R() {
    global $weakSource, $weakOld, $weakMaker1, $weakMaker2, $weakToken1, $weakToken2, $weakCapture, $weakReturned;
    echo 'SHUT|', $weakMaker1->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $weakMaker2->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureRepeat99R, '|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakToken1->get() === null, '|', $weakToken2->get() === null, '|', $weakReturned->get() === null, '|';
}
$captured = new CaptureRepeat99R(); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($captured);
$old = new OriginRepeat99R(); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$source = $old->capture($captured); $weakSource = WeakReference::create($source); unset($old, $captured);
$stop = new Exception('repeat99R'); $g = null; $warnings = 0;
set_error_handler('WarnRepeat99R'); register_shutdown_function('ShutdownRepeat99R');
for ($round = 1; $round <= 2; $round = $round + 1) {
    $maker = new MakerRepeat99R($round); $weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
    $token = new TokenRepeat99R($round); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
    if ($round === 1) { $weakMaker1 = $weakMaker; $weakToken1 = $weakToken; }
    else { $weakMaker2 = $weakMaker; $weakToken2 = $weakToken; }
    $fiber = new Fiber('RunRepeat99R'); echo 'START|', $round, '|'; $mark = $fiber->start();
    echo 'PARK|', $round, '|', $mark === 'RET', '|', $g === null, '|', $weakReturned->get() instanceof ReturnedRepeat99R, '|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakOld->get() instanceof OriginRepeat99R, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof TokenRepeat99R, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureRepeat99R, '|';
    if ($round === 2) { $source = null; }
    $maker = null; $token = null;
    echo 'HELD|', $round, '|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakOld->get() instanceof OriginRepeat99R, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof TokenRepeat99R, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureRepeat99R, '|', $weakReturned->get() instanceof ReturnedRepeat99R, '|';
    try { $fiber->throw($stop); echo 'BAD-OUT|'; }
    catch (Throwable $e) { echo 'OUT|', $round, '|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|', $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $g === null, '|', $weakReturned->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureRepeat99R, '|', ($round === 1 ? $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure : $weakSource->get() === null), '|', ($round === 1 ? $weakOld->get() instanceof OriginRepeat99R : $weakOld->get() === null), '|'; }
    unset($fiber, $e);
}
echo 'BOTH|', $weakMaker1->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $weakMaker2->get() instanceof MakerRepeat99R, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof CaptureRepeat99R, '|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakToken1->get() === null, '|', $weakToken2->get() === null, '|', $weakReturned->get() === null, '|E|';
restore_error_handler(); unset($stop);
